exposure: intrapartum deinfibulation in pregnant women with Type 3 Female Genital Mutilation/Cutting (FGM/C)
outcome: obstetric complications (episiotomy, prolonged second stage of labor, perineal damage, postpartum hemorrhage)
postpartum sexual function (Female Sexual Function Index scores)
cohort: Pregnant women with Type 3 FGM/C and puerperium patients at Nyala Turkish Training and Research Hospital in Sudan, mainly consisting of primiparous women.
finding: Deinfibulation in Type 3 FGM/C pregnant women was associated with improved labor performance (shorter second stage, less perineal damage), fewer obstetric complications, shorter hospitalization for mother and baby, and better postpartum sexual function.
mod_finding: Women with Type 3 FGM/C without deinfibulation experienced a significantly prolonged second stage of labor, greater perineal damage, and required more episiotomy procedures.
